ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(ISBLANK(Received_Cases__c), Received_Cases__c < 0, Free_Cases__c < 0, Received_Cases__c + BLANKVALUE(Free_Cases__c,0) <= 0, MOD(Received_Cases__c,1) <> 0, MOD(BLANKVALUE(Free_Cases__c,0),1) <> 0, ISBLANK(Pieces_Per_Case__c), Pieces_Per_Case__c <= 0, Case_Cost__c < 0)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter positive received cases and pieces per case. Free cases and cost cannot be negative.
